annotation.bound_parties_text: The non-binding European Parliament resolution only calls on the Commission, Member States, law enforcement and judicial authorities, and EU agencies, and imposes no binding obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.dates_quote: European Parliament resolution of 6 October 2021 on artificial intelligence in criminal law and its use by the police and judicial authorities in criminal matters (2020/2016(INI))
